For q>0: integer-vector lower bound lo^2*nu*nv<=a^2 checked exactly; LDL on hi^2 I-P_{k*}^T P_{k*} has all D>0 checked exactly with hi-lo=0.02<=0.05; all 120 runners k in 0..120, k!=k* excluded by exact Frobenius ceiling fr<lo with fr^2>=F2 or exact LDL B<lo; tail k>=121 bounded by Jordan majorant S=sum C(121,j)q^{121-j}U_j with U_j^2>=||N^j||_F^2 and S<lo (e.g. 1.99e-30 at q=1/2, 2.31e-09 at q=3/4), plus verified monotonicity (1-q)*121>=3 so C(k,j)q^{k-j} decreasing per j. Independent float SVD cross-check agrees: k*=0,2,3,4,5,7,11 with M_float 1.0,1.133429076,1.630232909,2.999943895,7.098087444,20.73922612,86.375712714 matching lo floors. Resolvent point data verified as exact inverse of (rI-C_q) with Klo^2<=(r-1)^2 a^2/(nu nv) and Frobenius point-hi fr^2>=F2R, e.g. K(1/2)>=3.191900 point-hi 3.208131. DRAFT honestly separates proof from conjecture: M/K>=1.5 NOT proved, no global two-sided Kreiss interval claimed, float SVD is guidance only. No essential inference or boundary condition fails.

originality.rationale: Substantive comparison, not timestamp: Mitchell arXiv:1907.06537 gives first globally convergent Kreiss-constant algorithms and K<=sup||A^k||<=e n K theory but publishes no peak index/value or Kreiss value for (z-q)^4 4x4 companions; Apkarian-Noll arXiv:1910.12572 computes/optimizes Kreiss constants for feedback design with Grcar-type examples, not frozen canonical companions; Reuter arXiv:1909.05931 gives analytic 2D-Jordan/subspace sufficient conditions for transients, no exact k*, M, K interval or gap for any 4x4 companion. arXiv 'Kreiss constant companion' all-fields search returns no relevant companion reference values. Internal SCOPE008 (continuous-time Hurwitz-stable n=8-16 Toeplitz exponentials, dimension-growth ratio) is disjoint in object (4x4 discrete-time companions vs n=8-16 exponentials), regime (Schur powers+resolvent vs Hurwitz exponentials), and conclusion. The exact two-sided M intervals, first-peak indices, and resolvent Kreiss lower bounds for this family are not mechanically implied by Jordan-disk or flat-portion facts and are not textbook substitutions.

value.rationale: Headline is a rigorously established exact invariant of a specific natural object, judged separately from the unproved M/K>=1.5 survey goal which DRAFT honestly discloses as conjecture (~2.22 numerically). Object (companion form = canonical control normal form; (z-q)^4 = canonical coalescent-spectrum maximally non-normal stable unit) and invariant (discrete-time power peak M(q)=max_k||C_q^k||_2 with first maximizer k*, plus resolvent Kreiss lower bounds) were motivated before computation by the recognized Kreiss Matrix Theorem sharpness program (how large transients a stable matrix can produce and how tightly K captures them), documented in Mitchell/Apkarian-Noll. Values were not known, are not closed-form or mechanically implied (k* moves 0,2,3,4,5,7,11; M grows 1 to ~86.38 non-trivially), and the certified table with exhibiting witnesses and replayable verifier is directly reusable as a Kreiss/transient solver benchmark. This is the eligible narrow-datum case: one exact order/index/witness table that a future researcher could reasonably need. Certification does not substitute for motivation here — motivation is independently present — and incompleteness of the surrounding Kreiss-gap census does not erase the headline peak table.
